svg.aria-label: Status v0.2.0. Implemented and tested: Contracts, Action IR, owner authority, Inference, registry, routing, Filesystem, terminal, process tools, Executor with durable ledger, LangGraph orchestration + recovery, Goal verification (14 predicates), Coding worker and critic, Durable restart (PostgreSQL 16), NomadicBrain planning, MAP loop, trace reconstruction, Skills, security-research lane, Owner API and owner console, Multi-agent missions (run --agents), Plan-quality checks (brain), Append-only scrubbed audit log, CI on Linux and Windows. Partial: Cloud inference (free models only, lightly live), Parallel missions (fakes only), Brain deliberation (partly tested), Docker tool (no dedicated tests), Desktop control (Windows foundation), Semantic memory + object graph, Vision verification (seam only), Evaluation-driven routing. Not yet: Measured live reliability, images sent to vision models.
